append.detail: BUILT 2026-10-12 (meta scan follow-up). Read against production first: /events/<slug> answers PRERENDER with a public cache-control, /market/<id> answered MISS with private, no-store. Two causes. (1) The proxy sets the fq_mkt discovery stamp on an anonymous first view, so that response is private by design; the repeat view with the stamp retained is the shared-cache HIT the evidence wants. (2) A service listing called listOpenSlots and getSpaceBookingTimezone, which resolve the viewer from the session cookie: every service listing rendered per request and showed an anonymous visitor no slots. The page now reads listPublicOpenSlots and the new getPublicSpaceBookingTimezone after it has confirmed the Space publicly visible; availability stays current and authenticated because bookServiceAction holds the chosen slot against live bookings at booking time. Invalidation already existed: commerce-actions and review-actions call revalidatePath(`/market/<id>`). The probe the row names now exists: scripts/check-public-market-detail.mjs checks the source half (revalidate export, no session read at render, the public readers, the revalidatePath calls) and with --require-runtime validates scripts/evidence/public-market-detail.json, which scripts/capture-public-market-detail.mjs writes from any machine that reaches production (anonymous first view, repeat view with the stamp retained, malformed and private ids answering 404), bound to a digest of the sources. It exits 79 until that file is captured against a deploy carrying this tree; the sandbox this landed from cannot reach production, so the capture is the one step left.
